Roast notes, issue 14, November 2026

Two new coffees for the cold months

November brings the first lots of the Kenyan main crop and a Guatemala
we have waited on since spring. Both go on the shelf on Tuesday 3
November, next to the two coffees most of you already drink.

Kenya Nyeri, New this month
Washed, from smallholders around Nyeri
Blackcurrant, pink grapefruit and brown sugar. Bright and juicy as
filter.
£13.50 for 250 g
Shop Kenya Nyeri:
https://sandersaxbuilds.github.io/selected-work/email-kit/sample-link.html?link=kenya-nyeri

Guatemala Huehuetenango, New this month
Washed, from the western highlands
Milk chocolate, red apple and almond. Easy as espresso or filter.
£11.00 for 250 g
Shop the Guatemala:
https://sandersaxbuilds.github.io/selected-work/email-kit/sample-link.html?link=guatemala

Ridgeline Blend
Our house espresso, Brazil and Colombia
Cocoa, hazelnut and caramel. Holds its own in milk.
£9.50 for 250 g
Shop Ridgeline Blend:
https://sandersaxbuilds.github.io/selected-work/email-kit/sample-link.html?link=ridgeline-blend

Colombia Decaf
Sugarcane process, from Huila
Panela, orange and a soft finish. A decaf that still tastes of coffee.
£10.50 for 250 g
Shop the decaf:
https://sandersaxbuilds.github.io/selected-work/email-kit/sample-link.html?link=colombia-decaf

On the bar: 1 to 16
We brew filter at 15 g of coffee to 240 g of water. For the Kenya, grind
a touch finer than usual and aim to finish the pour at three minutes.

Read the brew guide:
https://sandersaxbuilds.github.io/selected-work/email-kit/sample-link.html?link=brew-guide

Saturday cupping, 14 November
Taste all four coffees side by side at the roastery from 10am. It is
free and there is no need to book.

See the cupping details:
https://sandersaxbuilds.github.io/selected-work/email-kit/sample-link.html?link=saturday-cupping
